About Me

Engineering Tomorrow's Solutions

I'm Andrea Aston, a dedicated Electronics & Computer Engineering student with a passion for creating technology that solves real-world problems. Born and raised in Malawi, I'm committed to contributing to Africa's technological development.

My journey in engineering started with a fascination for how electronic devices work. This curiosity led me to pursue formal education in electronics and computer engineering, where I developed skills in embedded systems, microcontroller programming, and software development. At RFL, I work as a Robotics Technician where I apply theoretical knowledge to practical robotic systems. This hands-on experience has deepened my understanding of automation, control systems, and mechanical integration.
